## PRIORITY / DEADLINES

- **Workshop paper (56cc7f88)** – *Draft & Reviewer reply due by Wed 05‑Jun*  
  - Need to review Maya’s outline, propose any missing ablation tables, finish the abstract.

- **ICLR rebuttal (927a4e34)** – deadline **Day 19** (Mon 09‑Jun)  
  - Finalize rewrite‑vs‑append ablation results (H100 GPU run) and report baseline accuracy drop at >40 items.

- **GPU quota (ca4aab4c)** – 2400 H100 GPU‑hrs May‑Jun  
  - Schedule 80 hr/day over first 20 days for rewrite‑vs‑append sweep + periodic consolidation.

- **Lab meeting** – Wed 07‑Jun 11:00 AM  
  - Brief on consolidation strategy and MemGPT‑paging rollout.

---

## ACTIONS

| Item | What | Owner | Deadline |
|------|------|-------|----------|
| 1. Workshop outline | Review, add ablation tables, summarize MemGPT baseline | You | Wed 05‑Jun |
| 2. Rewrite‑vs‑append ablation code | Integrate MemGPT virtual paging (naive‑append baseline) + periodic consolidation | Dev | Thu 00‑Jun |
| 3. Execute GPU sweep | 2400 GPU‑hrs ≤ 80 hr/day | Dev | 20 days (Mon 00‑Jun–Fri 19‑Jun) |
| 4. QA accuracy analysis | Plot accuracy vs. store size for both baselines | You | Fri 00‑Jun |
| 5. Draft ICLR reply | Summarize ablation findings, emphasize periodic consolidation benefits | You | Mon‑Wed 06‑Jun |

---

## DRAFTED REPLY (to Maya)

> Hi Maya,
> 
> Thanks for the outline. I’ll add a section on the MemGPT‑style virtual paging baseline (neither rewrite nor simple append) and a panel comparing rewrite vs. naive‑append. I’ll also update the ablation table to include the periodic consolidation effect we saw at >40 items. Let me know if you want any other metrics highlighted.
> 
> Cheers,  
>  
> *[Your Name]*

---

## OVERNIGHT IDEA

> Integrating MemGPT’s virtual context paging with periodic consolidation can provide a clean, reusable rewrite‑vs‑append benchmark that satisfies the ICLR reviewer’s isolation request while keeping GPU usage within the 2400 H100‑hour budget.

---

## NUDGE

- **GPU budget**: Allocate the first 6 days to warm up the baseline pipeline; if we hit >90 % utilization before Day 20, schedule a quick checkpoint review at the next meeting.
